note: SEPARATE from results/seed_manifest.json by design. The g6k sieve is a different engine; its byte-identity hashes are not comparable to the fplll path's and the two manifests must NEVER be merged (ADR-005). lint_g6k_manifest.py enforces disjointness.

determinism_contract.fplll_random_seed_for_basis: FPLLL.set_random_seed(S) before IntegerMatrix.random — fixes the input basis
determinism_contract.fplll_random_seed_for_sieve: FPLLL.set_random_seed(S) again immediately before sieving — the g6k sampler draws from fplll's global RNG, so this is what fixes the sieve RNG
determinism_contract.siever_params_seed: NOT a knob — SieverParams has no 'seed' key in fpylll e25ade8 / g6k c71e084; setting one is a silently-ignored no-op (verified 2026-06-04). Determinism comes from threads=1 + the two FPLLL re-seeds above, NOT from any g6k-level seed.
determinism_contract.march_note: INC-55. The ENV CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS are x86-64-v2, but g6k's ./configure defaults to --enable-native and appended AVX2/FMA on top, so the 2026-08-13 'v2 pin' was a no-op — the shipped .so was still AVX2 (objdump: 2390 ymm + 199 vfmadd) and kept SIGILLing on v2-only GitHub runners. Real fix 2026-08-14: pass --disable-native to g6k's configure so the ENV v2 target actually applies; the rebuilt .so is genuinely v2 (0 ymm/vfmadd/zmm) and runs on every runner. Reference re-captured from the true-v2 build (host box, self-consistent 2 runs) — the SHAs are unchanged from the AVX2 build (basis cf22519d…, rprof d4faf05a…), confirming this n=80/β60/seed42 probe is genuinely ISA-invariant. Retained v3 label under previous_v3_reference is historical only.
determinism_contract.rejects: threads>1 (multi-threaded sieve is a nondeterministic insertion-order race; no seed fixes it — Phase 0 verdict 2026-06-04)

reference.captured_machine: Re-captured 2026-08-14 (INC-55) from a genuinely-v2 Dockerfile.g6k build (--disable-native, so g6k's configure no longer appends AVX2/FMA over the v2 CXXFLAGS). Verified the rebuilt siever .so contains 0 AVX2/FMA/AVX512 instructions; self-consistent (bit-identical) across 2 in-image runs on the host box. The SHAs equal the earlier AVX2-build values, confirming this n=80/beta=60/seed=42 probe is genuinely ISA-invariant (an AVX2 vs pure-v2 binary produce the same basis + r-profile). Because the binary is now pure v2 it runs identically on every x86-64-v2+ runner, so the CI determinism-verify passes on any GitHub runner — that is the cross-machine guarantee.
reference.capture_note: Captured from a clean Dockerfile.g6k build: docker run --rm sdbkz-g6k:refv2 python3 scripts/g6k_probe.py --n 80 --beta 60 --seed 42 --json. To re-verify after any pin change, rebuild and run scripts/lint_g6k_manifest.py --sha-check --require-ref.
